findings: Literal centered sum expands same weighted squared-increment sum minus same weighted clock sum. Derived orthogonality gives its exact energy.
Mesh is actual finite supremum from supplied deterministic nondecreasing clock, repetitions and empty clock allowed. Sum of gaps telescopes, deriving MSE<=2mesh*elapsed.
Every caller supplied zero-mesh family converges in mean-square/native Lp2. Concrete uniformClock with n+1 cells proves its own mesh tends to zero, including T0.
Weighted family may vary per partition but has common deterministic bound and START permission; target is same weighted clock sum, not an unproved time integral.
scope_limits: Not yet quadratic variation of arbitrary full stochastic integral. No stopping-time partitions or arbitrary integrand-time-integral limit claimed.
